name: Return: Huigui
source:
Set in the another world "Ershi", Return tells a story about the scarred teenager, the hardships he will go through and how he will grow after traveling there, as well as the touching journey full of joy, sadness with the companion he met.

After being knocked down and unconscious, the protagonist has come to the completely different world "Ershi". Determined to return to his original world, he partake in the adventure along with his magic user companion. He will borrow the magic and the knowledge about "Ershi" of his companion to find the way home, and at the same time uncover the unknown in the depths of this world.

"Obviously... everybody... would flee when they see me."
"Why... are you... still willing to approach me?"
The companion who is hated by everyone in "Ershi" - Night, hopes to be accepted and live a simple and happy life, yet he is powerless to do so.
Until he rescue our protagonist who had the same experience as him - White by accident. However, he never expected the dark truth behind this seemingly perfect encounter...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.flyingv.cc/projects/29767/]crowdfunding page[/url]]
translation:
《归来》以异世界“贰始”为背景，讲述了伤痕累累的少年，穿越到异世界之后所经历的磨难和成长，以及与他遇到的同伴之间充满欢乐和悲伤的感人旅程。

主角被击倒昏迷后，来到了完全不同的世界“二食”。他决心回到原来的世界，与魔法师同伴一起踏上冒险之旅。他将借用同伴的魔法和关于“二食”的知识来寻找回家的路，同时揭开这个世界深处的未知。

“显然……每个人……看到我都会逃跑。”
“为什么……你还愿意接近我？”
《二十》中人人讨厌的同伴——夜，希望被接受，过上简单幸福的生活，却无能为力。
直到他阴差阳错地救出了和他有同样经历的主角——怀特。然而，他万万没想到，这场看似完美的邂逅背后却隐藏着黑暗的真相……

[翻译自[url=https://www.flyingv.cc/projects/29767/]众筹页面[/url]]
